newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products weak gas oil slips $3.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products weak gas oil slips $3.

text.p: NWE oil products were all weaker on Friday, traders said.
Gasoline was pressured by easier crude, losing $1 a tonne or so amid poor local demand. The arb to the U.S was reopening and was likely to be a focus of attention.
Naphtha was quiet and tracking crude lower.
Gas oil slid $3 a tonne. Heating oil premiums firmed $1 into France on good demand. Barge premiums were stable in thin volume.
High sulphur fuel oil barges gained a little ground amid talk that Thursday's sharp fall was a little overstated.
